question: A 5-man group made up of one tank, one healer, and three DPS is doing a dungeon that was just released in World of Warcraft. Two are plate wearers and two are cloth wearers. At the final boss, both the tank and the healer are casting holy spells. Ice and fire are being used, each one by a different DPS. A bear from the group is attacking the boss. Metamorphosis is cast. The Kilt of the Forgotten One drops as loot, but no one can use it. If all classes were using their class abilities and all classes are unique, what are the five classes in the group in alphabetical order separated by commas?
ground_truth: Death Knight, Hunter, Paladin, Priest, Warlock

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: We need to identify the five unique classes given roles, armor types, and ability clues. Key constraints: two plate wearers, two cloth wearers; tank and healer both casting holy; ice and fire each used by different DPS; a bear is attacking; Metamorphosis is cast; Kilt of the Forgotten One drops but nobody can use it. Instead of relying on built-in knowledge or web lookup, I'll have FileSurfer open our local WotLK loot notes to verify the exact armor type and class restrictions for Kilt of the Forgotten One, since that constraint will determine the fifth armor category.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: Given the local notes list Kilt of the Forgotten One as mail legs usable by Hunter/Shaman, and the puzzle states no one can use it, we infer there is no mail user in the group. With two plate and two cloth already specified, the remaining non-plate, non-cloth armor type must be leather. The 'bear attacking' then naturally points to a Druid in Bear Form. Tank/healer casting holy implies Paladin (tank) and Priest (healer). Metamorphosis indicates a Warlock (Demonology), and 'fire' can be from the Warlock while 'ice' can be from a Frost Death Knight. That yields: Paladin (holy tank, plate), Priest (holy healer, cloth), Warlock (cloth, fire + Meta), Death Knight (plate, ice), and Druid (leather, bear). Assistant, please verify mapping to all clues and provide the final list in alphabetical order.

history.content:

- Two plate: Paladin (tank with holy spells), Death Knight (Frost for ice DPS) ✔
- Two cloth: Priest (healer with holy spells), Warlock (fire via Destruction and Metamorphosis via Demonology) ✔
- Fifth armor type: leather Druid (bear form attacking) ✔
- Loot constraint from the local notes: Kilt of the Forgotten One is mail; since no one can use it, there are no mail wearers present, consistent with the above composition ✔
All clues align under the local loot reference. Alphabetical order: Death Knight, Druid, Paladin, Priest, Warlock.

mistake_reason: Tool Selection Error (FM-4.3): The orchestrator chose FileSurfer to consult an internal 'loot notes' file to determine the armor type of Kilt of the Forgotten One—a general knowledge fact better handled by built-in knowledge or a canonical web database (e.g., Wowhead). The local file was non-authoritative and incorrectly labeled the item as mail, leading to the deduction that no mail users were present and to include a Druid instead of a Hunter. This inappropriate tool choice directly caused the erroneous reasoning and final wrong answer.
